concerns.location: tasks.md:T004 verify step, T009 verify step
concerns.text: T004's verification requires `code/utils/verify_pii_removal.py` to pass and T009 re-runs it against the package, but no task in T001–T010 creates that script (plan.md's T-031b described it; the consolidated list dropped it). Consumer-before-producer with no producer: either add the script's implementation to T004 (or an earlier task) or fold it into T002/T004 descriptions explicitly.

T001 is tagged [P] (parallel-safe) yet its verification requires 'the documented command parses' — the command is `python -m code.main --mode sim`, and `code/main.py` with the `--mode sim` flag is only produced/integrated in T003–T004. As ordered, T001's verify step cannot pass until T003+ complete, so it is not actually parallel-safe. Either move T001 after T004, weaken its verify to a syntax/argparse check deferred to a later task, or drop the [P] tag.

The coverage table lists FR-007 as 'T008, T009 — after T005–T007', but T008's reproducibility test also consumes T006's sensitivity outputs and T007's report artifacts only indirectly; more importantly T009's package step depends on T008's reference file (`data/reproducibility_ref.json`) which the table does not state. Minor: make the T008→T009 artifact dependency explicit in the Order column.
